spans.s:
शुटीर m. (-रः) A hero.
 E. शौटीर-पृषो० ।

शुटीरता f. (-ता) Valour, heroism.
 E. शौटीर a hero, तल् aff., and the diph-
thong changed to the short vowel.

शुटीर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Heroism, prowess.
 E. शौटीर a hero, यत् aff.: see the last.

षुट्ट r. 10th cl. (सुट्टयति-ते)
 1. To disregard, to despise.
 2. To be small or
shallow.

सुट्ट r. 10th cl. (सुट्टयति-ते)
 1. To disregard, to despise.
 2. To be low, small, or shallow; also षुट्ट ।
